description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Featured' class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines a controller for managing and displaying featured products in the catalog extension, including methods for loading product data, processing images, prices, and generating the HTML view for the featured module.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Featured' module in the OpenCart catalog extension, responsible for displaying selected products with images, prices, and links.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load featured products data, process images and prices, and render the module view based on configuration and product settings.
